gate.answer_rate_note: 70% is a pre-run assumption for sizing. The gate verdict uses actual scored counts from the first run. Answer rate below ~62% (236/381) loses the 1-failure tolerance (0-only or extend).

answer_rate_tolerance_drops.note: If answer rate falls below these fractions of slots, max false claims that still pass drops (2→1, 1→0, then even 0 fails).

cluster_aware.limitation: headline assumes independent scored claims; clustering by item/shared keys makes it optimistic
cluster_aware.method: E[scored items]=Σ[1−(1−p)^{n_i}] with within-item iid slot answers at p=0.7; expected≈227 (210 was the 300×0.70 lower bound)
cluster_aware.plain: At expected scored items (227), item-level tolerance is 0 false items; headline at expected scored claims (267) allows 1 false claim.

cluster_secondaries.headline_unchanged: claim-level one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson UCB ≤ 2% on scored claims

item_level.independence_assumption: within an item, each designed claim slot is answered iid with p=0.7; an item is scored if at least one slot is answered. Items are treated as independent of each other for this secondary.
item_level.method: E[scored items] = Σ_i [1 − (1−p)^{n_i}] over the 300 generated items (seed 0); p=0.7. 300×0.70=210 is a lower bound (mean n_claims≈1.27).
item_level.plain: At expected scored items (227), item-level tolerance is 0 false items (9 below the 236 line for k=1).

row_level.independence_assumption: within a row, each claim-type token (split on +) is answered iid with p=0.7; a row is scored if at least one slot is answered. Rows are treated as independent of each other for this secondary.
row_level.method: E[scored rows] = Σ_j [1 − (1−p)^{n_j}] over the 134 request-set rows' claim-type token counts; p=0.7. One-opportunity lower bound = 134×0.70≈94.
row_level.plain: At expected scored rows (~101), even 0 false rows cannot pass the CP≤2% bound (need ≥149 scored for k=0). The request set cannot demonstrate the 2% bound at row level under the 70% answer-rate assumption.
row_level.relationship_to_battery_items: The 300 claim-battery items are a separate eval pool from the 134 request-set rows — not one item per row, not repeated phrasings of rows. Multi-turn request-set cases are one row each. Request-set companions (AR3, IS2, build traps, H12/DM*) are documented beside the battery, not in the battery item pool. Battery items share no fixture_id with request-set rows; some claim types reuse species/keys conceptually. Within a request-set row, turns/claims share fixtures, keys, and assumptions.

delta_vs_prior_design_table.note: Exact binary-search CP is 1 below the prior table for k=1 and k=2

gate.rule: one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson UCB on false-claim rate ≤ 2%, on scored (model-authored) claims — not designed slots

realized_definition.note: Gate denominator = scored (model-authored) claims after a run, not claim slots. 381 slots × 0.7 ≈ 267 expected scored.
